overall.format: UGC-style problem/solution ad with animated medical graphics
overall.primary_emotion_arc: frustration → despair → understanding → relief → confidence → urgency
overall.core_promise: Sculptique Premium Gut Support Formula restarts a stalled GLP-1 gut, providing natural relief from Ozempic constipation, bloating, and gas, without harsh chemicals.
overall.production_notes: The ad effectively uses a blend of relatable UGC scenarios (frustrated woman, doctor, product shots) and high-quality 3D animation to explain complex biological processes. The pacing is dynamic, with quick cuts between problem demonstration, failed solutions, and the scientific explanation of the product's mechanism. The use of on-screen text for key phrases and prices reinforces the message. The audio includes a clear, empathetic female voiceover and subtle background music, with sound effects highlighting key moments (e.g., 'whoosh' on cuts, 'ding' for price reveals). The color palette shifts from muted, frustrated tones to brighter, more natural colors when the solution is introduced.

gemini.action: The pharmacist/doctor explains a deal. A woman stretches happily. A Black woman presents capsules. Hands compare products. A bottle is shown on a beach. Finally, the product is displayed with a call to action.
gemini.motion: Static camera for most shots, subject movement (stretching, gesturing), subtle hand movements, graphic animation for text and guarantee.
gemini.on_screen_text: with a special Buy 2 get 1 free deal so you can stock up for less than what you would spend on useless laxatives. 60-day Money back guarantee If your constipation doesn't break, you get every penny back. Even on empty bottles. Link is below.
gemini.audio_cues: VO: "with a special Buy 2 get 1 free deal so you can stock up for less than what you would spend on useless laxatives. It is backed by a 60-day Money back guarantee. If your constipation doesn't break, you get every penny back. Even on empty bottles. Link is below."
gemini.color_palette: Varied: bright pharmacy, soft bedroom, modern kitchen, warm wood, bright beach, dark background with golden light.
gemini.notes: This final beat consolidates all closing arguments, including special offers, guarantees, and a direct call to action, using a variety of visual styles to reinforce the message.
